blocks.text: Memo: units per hour is a team number, not a hunt

This is the working cut for PCF-MEM-2024-088 on August 15, 2024. Marcus Hale asked for a written bound after the current path (Whiteboard ranks 1-12 by UPH only) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host huddle.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on public individual UPH rank, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Post team UPH and team mispick rate. Take down the individual rank board. Coaching stays private. I am not restating a hallway yes. public individual UPH rank is out because The July board lasted 9 days. Skip-scan returned on 4 people chasing the top line. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: days=9, people=4, ranks=12, uph=310, miss=1.4, weeks=2, board=1, private=1. Sibling tickets PCF-2044 and PCF-MTG-2024-011. I will not reopen public individual UPH rank in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Post team UPH and team mispick rate. Take down the individual rank board. Coaching stays private.

Ticket PCF-MEM-2024-088 names the pull. If those numbers moved after August 15, 2024, update this file in review, do not 'correct' them in a group chat.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: rf.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (18): refuse on public individual UPH rank, lock is team UPH plus mispick, no public rank. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-2044.
A board that ranks people by UPH is how skip-scan came back.

What a skeptical lead would try first on huddle.pinecrest.internal: the path Marcus Hale actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock

What I will not claim in PCF-MEM-2024-088

I will not claim public individual UPH rank is impossible at another shop. I will claim we will not do it here. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host huddle.pinecrest.internal.
First useful slice for PCF-2044

First useful is team UPH plus mispick, no public rank, not a prettier board or a louder huddle. Marcus Hale sees that slice on huddle.pinecrest.internal. If the slice needs a second process, that is a new ticket and Marcus Hale is in the thread. I will not hide it inside PCF-MEM-2024-088.
